content: Jino uujoho amɨɨhai igaivomɨnaa quillahutoco faguehi. Jino uujoho diitobadɨro quillahutoobo iicaabo, bu Cristo ɨdaasuno iicaunoco aatyɨmeubo icano. Jaamo bu diito iicabadɨro uujoho tamañoma icaji Jesu ihovosɨɨma ufucu asaadɨ.

Jaaneguiiha amɨɨhai quillahuto, Moocaanico imiyaavugucuumo ovejamɨbadɨ iicamoco motoomo amɨɨhaico utuumusumoco. Jaanoco mihimogomoro momoonɨ Moocaani imogobadɨ. Jillɨ amɨɨhaico atajɨɨbaneguiiharo icatɨno, bu jillɨ nɨhɨbamɨcoro magaayɨcɨquiro icatɨno icano. Jillɨro imino mududɨcamaaje.
Amɨɨhaiñocoro mihicabadɨ mihimogobadɨro momoonɨdino. Jaamo amɨɨhai momoonɨnoco aatyɨmemere igaajaqui.
Tollɨ momoonɨhachiijɨ, imiya toomomɨnaafi agasedɨ amɨɨhai magaayɨcɨji imino chaahimɨgaco, mɨllɨ icajitɨnoco.
Jaabadɨro bu amɨɨhai sɨcafe quillahuto iijɨguiinovɨ miminifoto. Jaamoro sabadɨro sɨɨcujeebɨɨma mihicamoro fahɨgovavɨ: Jii, monoocasi:

content.text: Mɨɨro Moocaani imogotɨhi: Aivo uujoho sihidɨ jeevahi, eneefimoco. Jaanotɨ naha sɨɨcujeebɨɨma iicamoco iimihuseri amusufiibo.

content: miminifoto amɨɨhaico diibo unuufucu agasedɨ sihidɨ mejeevamotɨ iminiiyuqui.
Jaaneguiiha paryɨ amɨɨhai esamaajeque Moocaani usefañoro mificu. Mɨɨro diibo amɨɨhai imino mihicanoco imeguehi.
Jaamoro bu imino magaajamoro mehesɨcɨnɨ. Mɨɨro oono amɨɨhaimɨnaafi ɨjɨ jɨcubadɨ nɨɨgooboro ɨguehi, aatyɨmeme miyaavogoco ifinɨsuqui.
Jaaboco mejenaau miyaavogofañodɨ sefano mihicamoro, tollɨro bu fahɨgova iicamo amɨɨhai nahabomɨ, tobadɨro bu ɨdaasuno iicanoco magaajamoro.

Jaarumo gueenejɨsuno ɨdaasuno mihicanobuunatɨ Moocaani amɨɨhaico imino imibachujiibo, bu quehecuno, mityano, sefano icano ficujiibo. Jaabo diiboro Moocaani paryɨ fanoovaaco aacɨfiibo mɨɨhaico cuuhuvahi Jesucristoma sano ifinɨjitɨno fiivofaño miicaqui.
Jaabo jaafa mityama icahi fahiijɨvaro. Fɨne.

Jino tañahabobadɨ eesɨcɨnɨubo Silvano onoobofeenedɨ jihaamegayɨco caatɨnɨhi amɨɨhaico fajɨɨnɨɨboro miyaano iicanoco oono Moocaanitɨ paryɨ magaayɨcɨneheje Moocaani mɨɨhaico sihidɨ agaijɨnoco ɨjɨɨbogono. Jaanofañodɨ quehecuno mihica.
Tollɨro bu Moocaani iija Babiloniari iicajamɨnaa Moocaani amɨɨhaico iicaubadɨro ɨɨcɨumo amɨɨhaijaago iijɨco galluhi, bu tollɨro diibo taseemenebadɨ iicaabo Marco onoobo amɨɨhaijaago iijɨco galluhi.
Jaanegui fahɨgovavɨ mihibɨcɨcasimoro midillucasi. Jaamo paryɨ amɨɨhai Jesucristota mihicamo sajeebɨɨma mihica.

footnotes.text: Griego iijɨri janaanɨcɨ jillɨ noonɨcɨno: Moocaani useguiino.
